summary: Review comparison/alternative pages for symmetric evidence, scoped competitor claims, switching assumptions and proof proportional to buyer commitment.

must_inspect.why: A comparison is only decision-useful when the compared dimensions and population are explicit.
false_positive_guards: Do not require identical products to be compared on every feature.

must_inspect.why: Claims about another product create an external-truth burden separate from copy quality.
false_positive_guards: Do not call a competitor claim false merely because the page does not prove it. Route verification externally when needed.

must_inspect.why: Migration or switching claims can hide operational effort that changes the decision.
false_positive_guards: Do not invent switching costs not present in scope.
Preserve unknown external facts as VERIFY_EXTERNAL.
